dispositions.trace: Version has u64 major/minor/patch and Prerelease/BuildMetadata fields, with derived Ord/PartialOrd. Version::parse422-424 delegates to FromStr25-82, which requires numeric components separated by dots, parses optional prerelease/build segments, and rejects trailing text. Numeric parsing156-184 rejects leading zeros and u64 overflow; identifier220-260 admits only ASCII letters/digits/hyphens separated by nonempty dots, forbids leading-zero numeric prerelease segments and allows build numeric leading zeros. Prerelease ordering50-105 places a nonempty prerelease below the corresponding stable release, compares numeric identifiers by length then lexicographically, and handles numeric versus nonnumeric identifiers. Build metadata ordering107-150 is a derived Version tie breaker; the guard does not use cmp_precedence. Therefore0.20.0-rc.1 remains below the stable0.20.0 threshold, while0.20.0+build is above the empty-build stable threshold and is rejected.
